theme: Open water, a few bookings to close before you dock.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. You're mid-charter in the Adriatic with an open calendar — the only things asking for you are a handful of travel bookings closing this week, best handled from dry land before you're back offline.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Due today in Todoist (p1). A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the market's hardest rental and sells out early — book it refundable now and firm the dates later.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat handoff
needsAttention.detail: Charter ends noon Sat Sept 19 at Komolac and the hotel is booked, but the transfer, an early bag hold, and the pre-dawn Sept 20 checkout and airport taxi are still open. Arrange them from shore before connectivity drops.

needsAttention.title: Car and first nights in St Pete
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sun Sept 20. The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV (p1) and the Sept 20–21 St Pete lodging gap are both still unbooked, and the Sept 27–Oct 5 Airbnb is pending host confirmation — worth a glance to make sure it converted.

inbox.noise: The overnight inbox is all newsletters, promos, LinkedIn invites, and routine billing notices — nothing job-search or time-sensitive.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Pork chops with roasted beets & escarole salad
recipe.why: Peak-autumn cooking — beets and escarole are at the market now, and a good chop is the kind of unfussy, technique-forward supper this stretch of September calls for.

acts.line: A clear calendar — the sailing course has the day, not your inbox.
Nothing scheduled; the one thing worth chasing ashore is the Sept 19 Cavtat handoff before you're offline again.
An easy close — the girls are with Jen this stretch, so the night is genuinely yours.
